dev.files.archive_offset.note: Error shown after "error trying to download file: " when a download of shared files asks for a part past the end of the zip archive (an app fault). {offset} is the position asked for, in bytes.

dev.files.archive_too_big.text: the archive is {size} bytes: download it in parts
dev.files.archive_too_big.note: Error shown after "error trying to download file: " when an older app asks for a whole shared zip archive at once and it is larger than 4 MB. {size} is the archive's size in bytes.

dev.files.asset_not_found.note: Error reply when a file of the web app itself (a script, a picture) asked through the bridge doesn't exist on the device.

dev.files.bad_path.text: no file can be saved as {path}: a path starts with /, doesn't end in /, and none of the names in it is . or ..
dev.files.bad_path.note: Error shown after "error trying to upload file: " or "error trying to link file: " when an app asks to save a file at a path the device refuses: one that doesn't start with /, ends with / (no file name), or has a folder or file named . or ... An app fault. {path} is the path asked for, such as /Photos/../a.jpg.

dev.files.bad_size.note: Error shown after "error starting the upload: " when an app starts an upload with a negative size, or one larger than any disk (an app fault).

dev.files.chunk_too_big.note: Error shown after "error receiving the upload: " when an app sends a piece of an upload larger than the device takes at once (an app fault). {limit} is that largest size in bytes (4194304).

dev.files.cloud_ids_failed.note: Error reply during the iPhone's photo sync when the device could not check which iCloud photos it already has. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.files.collection_needs_name.note: Error reply when creating or renaming a collection (a group of photos chosen by the owner) with an empty name.

dev.files.compress_failed.text: the device could not compress this file
dev.files.compress_failed.note: Result of compressing one file in the background: re-encoding it failed (the device's own error may follow). The file was left as it was.

dev.files.compress_kept_version.text: an older version of a file keeps this content, so compressing it would free no space
dev.files.compress_kept_version.note: Why a file picked to compress can't be: an upload-only folder keeps this same content as an older version of a file, so the device must keep its bytes anyway.

dev.files.compress_missing.text: this file's content isn't on the device's disks
dev.files.compress_missing.note: Why a file picked to compress can't be: the device lists it but its content is missing from its storage (a rare fault).

dev.files.compress_no_job.note: Error when an app asks for the progress of a compress job and the device has none (none started since it last restarted).

dev.files.compress_not_media.text: only photos and videos can be compressed
dev.files.compress_not_media.note: Why a file the owner picked to compress (Settings › Largest files, or Images: Compress) can't be: it is a document or other file, not a photo or video. Shown next to the file in the Compress dialog.

dev.files.compress_not_smaller.text: compressed, it came out no smaller, so the file was left as it was
dev.files.compress_not_smaller.note: Result of compressing one file (a photo or video, compressed in the background): the new file wasn't smaller than the original, so the device kept the original and threw the new one away.

dev.files.compress_nothing_to_gain.text: the device can't make this file noticeably smaller
dev.files.compress_nothing_to_gain.note: Why a photo or video picked to compress can't be: every way the device has (a lower resolution, HEVC, a smaller JPEG) would save less than 15%. Shown next to the file in the Compress dialog.

dev.files.compress_too_many.text: pick at most 500 files at a time
dev.files.compress_too_many.note: Error when an app asks for the compress options of more than 500 files at once.

dev.files.compress_unknown_preset.text: this way of compressing isn't available for this file
dev.files.compress_unknown_preset.note: Error for a file sent to be compressed with a choice the device doesn't offer for it (an app newer than the device, or the file changed). The file was left as it was.

dev.files.compress_upload_only.text: this file is in an upload-only folder, where nothing is replaced; turn upload only off there to compress it
dev.files.compress_upload_only.note: Why a file picked to compress can't be: it, or a copy of it, is in an upload-only folder (a folder whose files the device never deletes or replaces, keeping older versions). Upload only is turned off on the folder's lock in Files.

dev.files.content_changed.text: this file has changed since it was shown, so nothing was deleted: refresh and try again
dev.files.content_changed.note: Error in Images and Files when deleting a photo, video or file whose path holds other content than the one the app showed (it was replaced from another phone or computer, or edited, since the list was loaded). Nothing was deleted, with or without deleting every copy: the owner refreshes the list and deletes again if still wanted.

dev.files.content_missing.text: the content of {path} is missing on this device
dev.files.content_missing.note: Error shown after "error trying to retrieve file: " when the file is listed but its content is gone from the device's disks. {path} is the file's path on the device.

dev.files.content_unavailable.text: the content of {path} is missing or unreadable on this device
dev.files.content_unavailable.note: Error reply when a file's content could not be read from the device's disks (gone, or damaged) while opening, downloading or sharing it. {path} is the file's path on the device.

dev.files.content_unreadable.text: the content of {path} is unreadable on this device
dev.files.content_unreadable.note: Error shown after "error trying to retrieve file: " when the file's content is on the device's disks but could not be decrypted (damaged). {path} is the file's path on the device.

dev.files.copy_upload_only.text: a copy is in the upload-only folder {folder}: no copy was deleted
dev.files.copy_upload_only.note: Error in Images when the owner deletes a photo or video that is stored at several paths in Files and chooses to delete all of them: one of those paths is inside an upload-only folder, so none was deleted (all or nothing). Upload only: nothing in the folder can be deleted. {folder} is the path of that upload-only folder.

dev.files.cut_failed.text: the device couldn't cut the video
dev.files.cut_failed.note: Why a cut of a video couldn't be saved (ffmpeg failed on it): the {reason} of edit_failed, after "the edit could not be saved: ". Lower case, no full stop.

dev.files.cut_too_short.text: a cut has to keep at least half a second of the video
dev.files.cut_too_short.note: Error when the owner saves a cut of a video (the viewers' Edit on a video) that keeps less than half a second, or starts after the video's end. Nothing was changed.

dev.files.delete_failed.note: Error reply in Files when deleting a file or folder failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.download_failed.note: Error reply on the page that downloads files someone shared with a link, when the download failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.edit_failed.text: the edit could not be saved: {reason}
dev.files.edit_failed.note: Error when a turn or a crop of a photo couldn't be saved on the device. {reason} is why, in the device's words (a sentence of its own, in lower case). Nothing was changed.

dev.files.edited_copy_name.note: The name of the copy a photo edit saves next to the photo when the owner chooses Save as copy, before its extension: {name} is the photo's own name without its extension (IMG_1234 (edited).jpg). Keep it short, in parentheses, as a file name. A second copy gets a number after it.

dev.files.edits_unavailable.text: this device can edit photos once its update has finished: try again in a few minutes
dev.files.edits_unavailable.note: Error when the owner saves a turn or a crop of a photo while the device's update hasn't finished preparing its database for edits. Nothing was changed; it works again after the update.

dev.files.exif_unsupported.note: Error shown after "error trying to retrieve file info: " when the photo details (camera, date, place) are asked for a file that isn't a photo or video. {mime} is the file's type, such as application/pdf. EXIF is the name of the photo details format; keep it.

dev.files.favourites.note: Name of the collection (a group of photos chosen by the owner) every device has, listed first in Collections. Photos go in with the heart in the photo viewer.

dev.files.favourites_fixed.text: the Favourites collection can't be renamed or deleted
dev.files.favourites_fixed.note: Error reply when an app asks to rename or delete the Favourites collection, which every device keeps.

dev.files.file_not_found.note: Error reply when a video to play no longer exists at that path on the device.

dev.files.file_offset.note: Error shown after "error reading file: " when an app asks for a part of a file past its end (an app fault). {offset} is the position asked for, in bytes.

dev.files.folder_update_failed.note: Error reply in Files when making a folder upload only, or keeping it out of Images (or undoing either), failed. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.files.gallery_not_found.text: this link doesn't exist or has expired
dev.files.gallery_not_found.note: Error on the page a shared link to photos opens, and on the page that downloads files someone shared with a link (a ZIP), when the link is wrong, was deleted or has expired. Also shown in Settings > Shared Links.

dev.files.hash_check_failed.note: Error reply during a sync when the device could not check whether it already has a file's content. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.files.hash_content_missing.text: the content for that hash is missing on this device: upload it instead
dev.files.hash_content_missing.note: Error shown after "error trying to link file: " during a sync: the app asked to reuse content the device should have, but its content is gone; the app uploads the file instead. A hash is the fingerprint that names a file's content.

dev.files.image_grid_mismatch.text: the image says it is {width}x{height}, larger than its {grid_width}x{grid_height} grid
dev.files.image_grid_mismatch.note: Error shown after "error trying to retrieve file: " when a HEIC photo is damaged: it claims to be larger than the tiles it is made of. The four numbers are sizes in pixels (width x height); keep the x between them.

dev.files.image_too_large.text: the image is {width}x{height}, too large to process (over {limit} megapixels)
dev.files.image_too_large.note: Error shown after "error trying to retrieve file: " when a photo is too large for the device to convert for showing. {width} and {height} are its size in pixels (keep the x between them); {limit} is the largest the device handles, in megapixels (120).

dev.files.info_failed.text: error trying to retrieve file info: {detail}
dev.files.info_failed.note: Error reply when a photo's details (camera, date, place - "More info" in the viewer) could not be read. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.link_expired.note: Error shown after "error trying to download file: " on the page that downloads files someone shared with a link, when the link's time is up.

dev.files.link_failed.note: Error reply during a sync when the device could not add a file whose content it already has (the app skips sending the bytes again). {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.locked_by_parent.text: {name} is inside the upload-only folder {parent} - unlock {parent} to unlock it
dev.files.locked_by_parent.note: Error in Files when the owner turns off upload only on a folder inside another upload-only folder: the outer one still protects it. Upload only: nothing in the folder can be deleted. {name} is the folder's name; {parent} is the path of the upload-only folder above it.

dev.files.locked_by_parent_own.text: {name} is inside the upload-only folder {parent} - unlock {parent} first, then {name}
dev.files.locked_by_parent_own.note: Error in Files when the owner turns off upload only on a folder that is inside another upload-only folder and has upload only set itself: both must be turned off, the outer one first. {name} is the folder's name; {parent} is the path of the upload-only folder above it.

dev.files.media_not_found.note: Error reply when a photo or video to play could not be found, or its playing address has expired (shared galleries, posts, the viewer).

dev.files.memories_bad_date.text: the request needs a date written YYYY-MM-DD and a period of a day, a week or a month
dev.files.memories_bad_date.note: Error reply when an app asks for the memories (On this day) without a valid date or period (an app fault). YYYY-MM-DD is the date's technical format and stays as it is.

dev.files.memories_bad_hide.text: nothing to hide: the request doesn't name a photo, a day, a memory or a person
dev.files.memories_bad_hide.note: Error reply when an app asks to hide something from the memories (On this day) without naming a valid photo, day, memory or person (an app fault).

dev.files.memories_off.text: On this day is off: turn it on in Settings to see your memories
dev.files.memories_off.note: Error reply when the memories (On this day: photos taken on this day in earlier years) are asked for while the user has the feature turned off in Settings. The apps hide them then, so it is rarely shown. On this day is the feature's name, as in the apps' Settings.

dev.files.name_differs_by_spaces.text: "{name}" can't be saved: a file here has the same name with or without spaces at its end, and the device keeps only one of them - rename one
dev.files.name_differs_by_spaces.note: Error shown after "error trying to upload file: " when a computer or phone uploads a file whose name differs from a file already in the same folder only by spaces at the end of the name ("notes.txt" and "notes.txt "): the device can't keep both. {name} is the file's name, in quotes so that the spaces at its end show.

dev.files.no_low_res_photos.text: there are no photos to share in low resolution there
dev.files.no_low_res_photos.note: Error when sharing a collection or folder as a gallery with "low resolution" on, and it holds no photos (low resolution shares photos only).

dev.files.no_media_to_share.text: there are no photos or videos to share there
dev.files.no_media_to_share.note: Error when sharing a collection or folder as a gallery and it holds no photos or videos.

dev.files.no_path.note: Error shown after "error starting the upload: " when an app starts an upload without saying where the file goes (an app fault).

dev.files.no_such_hash.text: no file with that hash on this device
dev.files.no_such_hash.note: Error shown after "error trying to link file: " during a sync: the app asked to reuse content the device doesn't have. A hash is the fingerprint that names a file's content.

dev.files.no_such_job.note: Error reply while sharing a gallery: the app asks how the copy is going, and the device no longer knows that copy (it restarted, or the copy finished long ago).

dev.files.no_such_link.note: Error in Settings > Shared Links when deleting a link that no longer exists.

dev.files.no_such_path.note: Error shown after "error creating files share link: " when a file or folder chosen for sharing no longer exists. {path} is its path on the device.

dev.files.not_cuttable.text: this video can't be cut: the device can cut MP4, MOV, M4V, 3GP, MKV, WebM and AVI videos
dev.files.not_cuttable.note: Error when the owner saves a cut of a video (the viewers' Edit on a video: a start and an end) in a format the device can't cut without re-encoding it (MPEG-TS, WMV, FLV...), or of a file that isn't a video. Nothing was changed. Keep the format names as they are.

dev.files.not_editable.text: this file can't be edited: only photos can be turned and cropped, not videos, camera raws or animations
dev.files.not_editable.note: Error when the owner saves a turn or a crop (the photo viewer's Edit) of a file the device can't edit: a video, a camera raw (DNG, CR2, NEF...), an animated GIF or WebP, or anything that isn't a photo. Nothing was changed.

dev.files.not_edited.text: this photo has no edit to undo
dev.files.not_edited.note: Error when the owner chooses Revert to original for a photo that holds no edit any more (it was reverted, or replaced, from another phone or computer meanwhile). Nothing was changed.

dev.files.not_on_device.note: Error when sharing files as a gallery and one of the chosen files no longer exists. {path} is its path on the device.

dev.files.nothing_to_share.note: Error when sharing a gallery without choosing anything (no collection, folder or file).

dev.files.nothing_to_stream.note: Error reply when an app asks to play a video without saying which (an app fault).

dev.files.original_compressed.text: this file was compressed and its original deleted, so there is nothing to go back to
dev.files.original_compressed.note: Error when the owner chooses Revert to original for a file that was compressed: compressing deletes the original from the device for good.

dev.files.out_of_images_list_failed.text: error listing the folders kept out of Images: {detail}
dev.files.out_of_images_list_failed.note: Error reply when the list of folders kept out of Images could not be read. Images is the photos section; a folder kept out of it shows no photos there and gets no tags or faces. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.files.person_cover_image.text: that picture can't be used: it must be a JPEG of at most 256 KB
dev.files.person_cover_image.note: Error reply when the picture an app sends for a person's face (People: a photo of the owner's own, cropped in the app) isn't a JPEG, is larger than 256 KB, or isn't a picture at all (an app fault).

dev.files.person_cover_no_face.text: that photo has no face of this person
dev.files.person_cover_no_face.note: Error reply when the app asks to use the face in a photo for a person (People: Use this face) and none of the faces found in that photo is theirs (taken off them meanwhile, on another app).

dev.files.person_gone.text: that person is no longer on this device
dev.files.person_gone.note: Error reply to Someone else… (moving photos from one person found by face recognition to another) when the person picked was deleted, or merged into another, meanwhile - from another phone or browser, for example. Nothing was moved.

dev.files.person_missing.note: Error reply when an app asks to take photos off a person found by face recognition (Not this person), or to move them to another person, without saying which person (an app fault).

dev.files.person_no_photos.note: Error reply when an app asks to take photos off a person found by face recognition (Not this person), or to move them to another person, without naming any photo (an app fault).

dev.files.person_same.text: choose another person to move the photos to
dev.files.person_same.note: Error reply to Someone else… (moving photos from one person found by face recognition to another) when the person picked is the one the photos are taken from (an app fault).

dev.files.person_too_many.text: at most {max} photos at a time
dev.files.person_too_many.note: Error reply when an app asks to take more photos off a person found by face recognition (Not this person), or to move more of them to another person, than the device handles in one request (an app fault). {max} is that most (10000).

dev.files.places_off.text: Places is off: turn it on in Settings to see your photos on a map
dev.files.places_off.note: Error reply when the map of photos (Places, in Images) is asked for while the user has Places turned off in Settings. The apps hide the map then, so it is rarely shown. Places is the feature's name, as in app.shell.section_places.

dev.files.post_content_unavailable.text: the content of {hash} is missing or unreadable: {detail}
dev.files.post_content_unavailable.note: Error shown after "error trying to create publication: " when a file chosen for a post could not be read from the device's disks. {hash} is the fingerprint that names the file's content (64 letters and digits); {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.files.rating_bad_stars.text: a photo's rating is from 0 to 5 stars
dev.files.rating_bad_stars.note: Error reply when an app sends a rating with stars outside 0 to 5 (an app fault). 0 means no stars.

dev.files.rating_comment_too_long.text: a comment can be at most {max} characters long
dev.files.rating_comment_too_long.note: Error reply when the comment written under a photo's stars (collection Rating) is too long. {max} is the most characters allowed, 2000.

dev.files.rating_link_off.text: the photos of this link can't be rated any more
dev.files.rating_link_off.note: Error on the page a shared gallery link opens, when a visitor rates a photo but the link no longer takes ratings: its owner turned Rating off for the collection, or deleted the collection.

dev.files.rating_no_collection.note: Error reply when an app turns Rating on or off, or rates a photo, in a collection (a group of photos) that was deleted meanwhile, perhaps from another app.

dev.files.rating_not_in_collection.text: this photo is no longer in the collection
dev.files.rating_not_in_collection.note: Error reply, and an error on a shared gallery's page, when a photo is rated in a collection (a group of photos) it was taken out of meanwhile.

dev.files.rating_off.text: Rating is off for this collection: turn it on to rate its photos
dev.files.rating_off.note: Error reply when an app rates a photo in a collection whose Rating (1 to 5 stars and a comment per photo) is off, perhaps turned off from another app. Rating is the feature's name, as on the collection's button.

dev.files.read_failed.note: Error reply when reading a file (opening, downloading or syncing it) failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.reprocess_count_failed.note: Error reply in Settings when starting to analyse every photo again (reprocess) failed while counting them. {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.files.reprocess_read_failed.note: Error reply in Settings when starting to analyse every photo again (reprocess) failed while reading how far an earlier run got. {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.files.reprocess_resume_failed.note: Error reply in Settings when carrying on with an interrupted analysis of every photo (reprocess) failed. {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.files.reprocess_start_failed.note: Error reply in Settings when starting to analyse every photo again (reprocess) failed. {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.files.reprocess_wipe_failed.note: Error reply in Settings when starting to analyse every photo again (reprocess) failed while removing the tags and faces found before. {detail} is the reason, an error in English.

dev.files.retrieve_failed.note: Error reply when opening a file or photo failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.share_link_failed.note: Error reply in Files when making a link to download the chosen files failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.smart_search_downloading.text: Smart search is getting ready: the device is still downloading what it needs ({percent}%)
dev.files.smart_search_downloading.note: Error reply when an app searches photos by a description (Smart search) while the device is still downloading the model Smart search needs (about 400 MB, once, after Smart search is first turned on). {percent} is how far the download is. The apps don't offer the description search then, so it is rarely shown. Smart search is the feature's name, as in the apps' Settings.

dev.files.smart_search_model_failed.text: The download of what Smart search needs failed. The device tries again by itself in a while.
dev.files.smart_search_model_failed.note: Shown in Settings under the Smart search switch, with how far the download is, when the device's last try to download the model Smart search needs (about 400 MB) failed for another reason than the internet connection or the space - for example a damaged download. The device tries again by itself, a minute later at first and up to an hour later, while Smart search is on. Smart search is the feature's name, as in the apps' Settings.

dev.files.smart_search_model_no_space.text: There isn't enough space on the device for what Smart search needs: it takes {need}, and only {left} is free. The device tries again by itself in a while.
dev.files.smart_search_model_no_space.note: Shown in Settings under the Smart search switch, with how far the download is, when the device didn't download the model Smart search needs because it wouldn't fit: the device always keeps some space free for its own database. {need} is what is still to download and {left} what can be used, both sizes such as 380 MB. The device tries again by itself, a minute later at first and up to an hour later, while Smart search is on.

dev.files.smart_search_model_unreachable.text: The device couldn't download what Smart search needs: check its internet connection. It tries again by itself in a while.
dev.files.smart_search_model_unreachable.note: Shown in Settings under the Smart search switch, with how far the download is, when the device's last try to download the model Smart search needs (about 400 MB) couldn't get through: no internet connection, a download that stalled or was cut, or the server's own error. The device tries again by itself, a minute later at first and up to an hour later, while Smart search is on.

dev.files.smart_search_off.text: Smart search is off: turn it on in Settings to find photos by describing them
dev.files.smart_search_off.note: Error reply when an app searches photos by a description (Smart search) while the user has the feature turned off in Settings. The apps hide the description search then, so it is rarely shown. Smart search is the feature's name, as in the apps' Settings.

dev.files.smart_search_unavailable.text: Smart search isn't available on this device: it can't get what it needs
dev.files.smart_search_unavailable.note: Error reply when Smart search (finding photos by describing them) is turned on, or used, on a device that can't get the model it needs at all - for example it has nowhere to keep it. Smart search is the feature's name, as in the apps' Settings.

dev.files.storage_full.text: not enough space on the device: this needs {need}, and only {left} is left
dev.files.storage_full.note: Error shown after a sentence such as "error starting the upload: " when the device refuses to save something (an upload, a shared link or gallery, a post's video) because its storage disks are almost full: it always keeps some space free for its own database. {need} is what saving it takes and {left} what can still be used, both sizes such as 3.4 GB.

dev.files.stream_failed.note: Error reply when the device could not get a video ready to play.

dev.files.too_large_to_open.text: this file is too large to open here ({size}): download it instead
dev.files.too_large_to_open.note: Error shown after "error trying to retrieve file: " when the app asks the device for a whole photo or file to show it and it is too large for the device to send in one piece (the apps download large files in parts). {size} is the file's size, such as 1.2 GB.

dev.files.too_large_to_process.text: the file is {size}, more than this device can process at once (at most {limit})
dev.files.too_large_to_process.note: Error shown after "{name} could not be processed" in Alerts, or logged, when a photo or image file is too large for the device to read into memory to make its thumbnail and find what is in it: it is not processed and has no thumbnail. {size} is the file's size and {limit} the largest the device processes, both sizes such as 1.2 GB.

dev.files.upload_bad_hash.text: the upload's content doesn't match its hash
dev.files.upload_bad_hash.note: Error shown after "error finishing the upload: " when the uploaded file arrived damaged: its fingerprint (hash) isn't the one the app computed. The app sends it again.

dev.files.upload_failed.note: Error reply when uploading a file failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate (such as "Duplicated file", which stays English).

dev.files.upload_finish_failed.note: Error reply when the last step of an upload sent in pieces failed. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate (such as "Duplicated file", which stays English).

dev.files.upload_incomplete.note: Error shown after "error finishing the upload: " when an upload sent in pieces is finished before all of it arrived. {received} is how many bytes arrived; {size} is the file's size in bytes.

dev.files.upload_only.text: this folder is upload only: nothing in it can be deleted
dev.files.upload_only.note: Error in Files and the sync apps when deleting something inside an upload-only folder: the owner protected the folder so that nothing in it can be deleted, and re-uploads keep the old version.

dev.files.upload_out_of_order.note: Error shown after "error receiving the upload: " when a piece of an upload arrives before the one it follows; the app sends again from where the device is.

dev.files.upload_receive_failed.note: Error reply when a piece of an upload sent in pieces could not be received. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.upload_removed.text: the upload's content was removed before it was recorded - send it again
dev.files.upload_removed.note: Error shown after "error finishing the upload: " when the same content was deleted at the very moment the upload finished; the file has to be sent again.

dev.files.upload_start_failed.note: Error reply when an upload sent in pieces could not be started. {detail} is the reason: one of the device's own sentences, or an error in English it can't translate.

dev.files.upload_too_many.text: too many uploads under way at once
dev.files.upload_too_many.note: Error shown after "error starting the upload: " when an app has begun more uploads than the device keeps unfinished at once (32, across all of the user's apps); the app tries the file again later.

dev.files.upload_too_much.text: more data than the upload's size
dev.files.upload_too_much.note: Error shown after "error receiving the upload: " when an app sends more bytes than the size it announced (an app fault).

dev.files.upload_unknown.note: Error reply when an app goes on with an upload the device no longer knows (it was idle for 30 minutes, the device restarted, or the app went on with it over another connection); the app starts it again.

dev.files.versions_failed.note: Error reply when the earlier versions of a file (kept in upload-only folders) could not be listed. {detail} is the reason, usually an error in English the device can't translate.

dev.files.video_no_duration.note: Error when the device could not read how long a video is (damaged, or not really a video), so it can't make its preview picture.

dev.files.video_no_frames.text: could not extract any frames from video
dev.files.video_no_frames.note: Error when the device could not take any picture out of a video (damaged, or too short) to make its preview.

dev.files.video_no_frames_extracted.note: Error when the device could not take a picture out of a video it shrank for a post, to make its preview.

dev.files.video_not_cut.text: the video could not be cut, so nothing was posted: try again, or post it without cutting it
dev.files.video_not_cut.note: Error shown after "error trying to create publication: " when the owner cut (trimmed) a video for a post and the device could not make the cut copy. The post is not made at all, so the parts the owner cut out are never shared.

dev.files.video_not_edited.text: this video has no edit to undo
dev.files.video_not_edited.note: Error when the owner chooses Revert to original for a video that holds no cut any more (it was reverted, or replaced, from another phone or computer meanwhile). Nothing was changed. As not_edited, for a video.

dev.files.video_not_reduced.text: the video could not be made smaller for the post, and at {size} it is too large to share as it is
dev.files.video_not_reduced.note: Error shown after "error trying to create publication: " when a large video is posted: the device makes a smaller copy for friends, and here it could not, and the original is too large to send to friends instead. {size} is the original video's size, such as 3.2 GB.

dev.files.whole_library.text: the whole library can't be deleted at once: delete its folders or files instead
dev.files.whole_library.note: Error shown after "error trying to delete file: " when an app asks the device to delete everything in it at once (the path of the whole library, which no app's delete names: an app fault). Nothing is deleted.
